text:
Tasha: Quick cross-team check for Project Lattice pilot. Customer wants tenant isolation, HSM-wrapped keys, and deterministic p95 targets. We have a 5-week runway. Call out absolute blockers vs negotiable tradeoffs.

Liam: Runtime summary: hot-pool + prefix cache can supply burst to 80QPS for short windows. Absolute blocker: hot-pool implementation + ability to instant-swap routing (fallback route to hosted). Negotiable: quantization level—8-bit ok now, 4-bit later after eval. Perf validation needs 6 business days.

Ivy: Infra: can schedule GPUs but need SKU confirmation and IP allowlist details. Blocker: peering policy and egress path for their on-prem datacenter until SOC approves. Also request: 1TB cache NVMe and a dedicated subnet.

Ravi: Security: HSM integration must pass attestation before live keys. Shadow testing allowed but no live HSM until checklist done. Need key-rotation plan and an audit logging spec. Blocker until PR with ROTATION_DOC + ATTEST_PLAN is merged.

Noah: SRE: propose SLOs for pilot: p95 <= 220ms, p99 <= 600ms, error_rate < 0.6%. Canary plan: 10% shadow -> 10% live -> 40% -> 100% over 7 days with automated rollback triggers. Need oncall coverage for first 72h after live keys.

Gina: ML: if we ship 8-bit we expect <0.7% drop on our baseline metric for most prompts; will run an eval against their sample set. Need 1500 prompt eval set. If drop >1.2% we pause quantized path.

Paul: Finance: extra infra + HSM add ~$11k/month. If customer signs a 4mo commitment we can absorb half the incremental cost. Need product to include cost-commitment clause.

Liam: Proposed minimal launch gates:
- infra reserved and network validated
- HSM attestation checklist green (canary shadow OK)
- perf test p95 within 25% of hosted at 10% canary
- runbook + oncall slots filled
- cost terms signed or provisional approval
Owners: product=Tasha, runtime=Liam, infra=Ivy, security=Ravi, sre=Noah, ml=Gina, finance=Paul

Tasha: Two negotiation notes: customer prefers a 20% initial canary; we push back to 10% unless we get 4mo commit. Also they want a deterministic tail SLA; suggest we offer p95 guarantee for first 3 months with usage caps. Thoughts?

Ivy: 20% requires +2 GPUs for headroom; we can do it if finance approves and customer commits.

Paul: We can propose a trade: 4mo commitment & a 10% uplift on unit price -> we cover the additional GPUs. I'll draft numbers.

Ravi: Security caveat: if customer denies pen test access we must keep live keys off and run only shadow canary. Call this out in SOW.

Noah: Oncall plan: need two runtime engineers + infra lead for first 48h of live keys. Nominate Alex and Sam from runtime and Kim from infra.

Liam: Alex + Sam ok, will ping them. Perf tests scheduled next Tue; will post results here.

Gina: I'll prepare evaluation harness and ask product to collect the 1500 prompts by Wed.

ci-bot: Automation note: "Please attach runbook and secure approval from SecOps before scheduling deployment window."

Tasha: Action items and dates:
- Customer to deliver 1500 prompts by Wed
- Ivy reserve infra & subnet by Thu EOD
- Ravi publish attestation checklist & key rotation doc by Thu
- Liam run perf tests next Tue; results posted in this thread
- Paul draft cost/commit proposal by Fri
If any item slips, canary start moves by one week. Flag absolute blockers ASAP. :calendar: :hourglass:
